description: Binds the CUE-SPECIFIC INVESTIGATOR for a teacher-grown, cue-grounded CapabilityAxis (Wall D, 81d1ddea). Wall D made a grown axis carry the REAL acoustic cue the teacher named (advice 'use the F2 trajectory' -> axis keyed `f2_trajectory`, the matched AcousticCue carrying `operator: f2_formant`, a hint_grounding.CUE_MENU operator), but its `investigated_by` pointed at a GENERIC held Operator only to prove pickability -- so dispatching the axis did NOT measure its cue. This seed holds the cue-specific Operator (an Operator node, runner='cue_investigator') that the grown axis's investigated_by is re-pointed at (graph-data swap, precedent 4bca77bc/81d1ddea). When the investigation reflex dispatches the axis, the runner composes the cue's Term via hint_grounding.compose_from_spec(res, operator), evaluates the held Term on cue-appropriate audio via substrate.evaluate (donkey=0), and banks a cue-DERIVED MeasuredCapability via record_measured_capability (feeding the residual/shortfall -> residual-salience). The cue axis is now fully INVESTIGABLE -- it MEASURES its cue, not just names it. The measurement DECISION is the held composed cue Term (Rust evaluate); the Python (domains/cue_investigator.py) is mechanical DSP I/O (render -> ingest -> enrich the bands the Term reads). The investigated_by re-point is graph data; existing investigation_teacher.json / world_adapter.py / speech_world.py are left UNTOUCHED.
